scenes.headline: How two sandboxed agents can talk through shared hardware
scenes.sub: Covert channels, and what a defender can do
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Hush! Today: how two agents in separate sandboxes can still signal each other, and how you would notice.

scenes.text: A covert channel needs no victim and no stolen secret. Two cooperating ends disturb and time a shared hardware resource, and that is a wire.
scenes.mark: disturb and time a shared hardware resource
scenes.say: Both ends cooperate. One disturbs a shared resource, the other times it, and the pattern carries bits.

left.title: Side channel
left.say: In a side channel, a victim leaks and an attacker watches. Meltdown and Spectre are the famous cases.

right.title: Covert channel
items: They evade a policy, there is no victim
right.say: In a covert channel both ends agree to talk. The target is a policy, not a victim.

steps.say: Two sandboxes, no network, no shared file.
They share core time. One runs or idles, the other sees how much work it gets done.
They share a cache. One pushes lines out, the other times its own reads.
They share the memory bus. Heavy traffic from one slows the other.

scenes.title: How fast can a noisy channel talk
scenes.say: A toy channel's capacity is its raw rate times one minus the entropy of its error rate.

parts.say: H of p is the entropy of the bit error rate, and noise pushes it up.

scenes.label: capacity of my toy channel with 10 ms slots and no noise
scenes.note: within one process, on one CPU
scenes.say: My toy, two threads of one process, carried ninety two bits per second at best, and noise cut that fast.

scenes.text: Shared hardware is a communication medium. List the resources you share before the attacks you have heard of.
scenes.say: List what your tenants share, then partition it, throttle it, or watch it.
Covert is not a side channel. Three shared resources. Partition, throttle, and watch.
